card.name: Merengue
card.era: Mid-19th century to present; national symbol under Trujillo
card.tagline: The national music and partner dance of the Dominican Republic.
card.profile: Merengue is the national music and dance of the Dominican Republic, danced in pairs in a 2/4 rhythm with a steady marching/side-to-side basic step and characteristic hip motion from weight changes. The core conjunto tipico features the diatonic accordion, the tambora (two-headed drum) and the guira (metal scraper) - symbolizing European, African and Taino cultures. Flirtatious gestures accompany the dance; it pervades daily life from celebrations to political campaigning. On 26 November 2005 the DR president decreed a National Merengue Day (UNESCO; English Wikipedia).
card.insight: UNESCO inscribed 'Music and dance of the merengue in the Dominican Republic' in 2016 (file 01162), noting it attracts people of different social classes and promotes coexistence among communities (UNESCO).
